policies.title: Foreign CEMAC ordinary passports: Central African Republic visa-free short entry
policies.summary: CEMAC's current Commission material says visa-free movement for Member-State citizens is effective. This directly maps the five other current CEMAC member-state ordinary passports to visa-free entry to the Central African Republic; no current CAR source was found to extend that rule beyond the bloc.
conditions: Applies only to nationals holding ordinary passports of the five other current CEMAC Member States: Cameroon, Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea and Chad.
The current CEMAC publication establishes visa-free movement but does not itself publish a CAR-specific visitor duration, accepted-document, port or fee schedule. None is inferred here.

Work, establishment, long-term residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and other special-document arrangements are outside this ordinary short-visitor policy. Passport, health, public-order, security and individual admission controls may still apply.
